verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a UI framework's ecosystem, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no Solid-owned CLI, let alone one aimed at AI-native or agentic workflows. The only command-line item is `npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app`. That uses degit, a third-party scaffolding tool, to copy official templates, so it is an external tool and does not count as Solid's own CLI.
